question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Make a living

options.text: To earn enough money for things you need

solution:
The correct answer is **"To earn enough money for things you need"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The meaning of the idiom "make a living" is to earn the money one needs to pay for housing, food, etc.
 
• Idiom "make a living" का अर्थ है वह धन अर्जित करना है जो आवास, भोजन आदि के लिए भुगतान करने के लिए आवश्यक है।​​
 
 
• Example: *He **made a living**__ by working as a cook.*
 
 
 
• ​Therefore, the one that represents the appropriate meaning of the idiom is **'****To earn enough money for things you need.'**
 
• Hence, the correct answer is Option 3.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's check for the other idioms with the word **"living"**:

 
 
• **Living the dream:** having a lifestyle that is perceived as wonderful or perfect.
 
• **Live down:** to get beyond anything you did in the past that was really embarrassing or a significant error.
 
• **Live to: **to continue existing until a particular age.
